subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>, Emily Patel <emily.patel@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodai.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)

Hi Alex / Emily 

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can get aligned on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. I attached a short POC outline and the recording for reference.

What we demoed (high level)
- Redwood hosted inference for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) + streaming responses
- Dedicated option with isolated GPU pools for predictable latency
- Token-level cost breakdowns and per-route dashboards in Redwood Console
- Built-in fallback to smaller quantized variants for graceful degradation

Proposed POC objective
- Validate that Redwood can serve FinServCorp's account-summary and customer-support prompts at <= 250ms p50 token latency under expected concurrency (50 concurrent sessions), with costs that fit your 3-month evaluation budget.

Suggested success criteria (proposed  please adjust)
1) Latency: p50 generation latency <= 250ms and p95 <= 700ms for 512-token sessions
2) Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions with <10% error rate
3) Functional: accurate entity redaction and secure logging (no sensitive PII persisted in plaintext)
4) Cost: estimated token cost < $X/month (placeholder  we'll provide an estimate once we know volume)

High-level POC plan & timeline (3-6 weeks)
- Week 0: Kickoff + security questionnaire handed off to Redwood security (we can run the SSO/KMS integration in parallel)
- Week 1: Baseline tests with sample prompts & dataset, get latency/throughput baselines
- Week 2: Integrate prefix caching and batching settings; run scale tests
- Week 3: Final validation and handoff to your platform team for signoff

Owners
- FinServCorp: Alex (stakeholder), Emily (procurement + budget)
- Redwood: Marissa (AE, POC coordinator), Dylan (Solutions Engineer), Connor (Security/Privacy lead)

Next steps
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or add items you care about (regulatory, logging retention, audit log exports).
2) Can we target kickoff the week of Aug 3? I'm including a 30-min scheduling link below.
3) I've attached the POC outline and the demo recording for internal review.

Attachments: POC-outline.pdf, Demo-recording-20260728.mp4

Thanks  happy to iterate this based on your priorities.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodai.com | (415) 555-0187
https://redwood.ai/
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>

Cc: Emily Patel <emily.patel@finservcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)

Marissa  thanks for the recap and the recording. The demo looked solid and we're interested in moving forward with a time-boxed POC. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: the latency numbers look reasonable; we'd like to add one more functional item - automated redaction for account numbers (we can provide sample prompts).
- Security: Emily will own procurement, but our security team needs SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short summary of how you handle KMS/HSM and audit logs. Can you provide existing artifacts or a pointer?
- Timeline/budget: procurement runs on a 3-week cadence for evals. We'd likely need a 3-month trial window. Please send a rough cost estimate for a 3-month POC at ~1M tokens/month and for the Dedicated option.

If those are doable we can aim for an Aug 3 kickoff; Emily, any procurement constraints?

 Alex
Director, AI Platforms
FinServCorp
alex.johnson@finservcorp.com | +1 617 555 0199

Updated POC timeline (target kickoff week of Aug 3)

- Week 2: apply batching/prefix caching + scale test to 50 concurrent sessions

Requested items from FinServCorp

- Confirmation of the redaction examples you want validated (account numbers)
- Procurement contact/POC for contract & payment cadence (Emily?)

Next steps
1) I'll share the SOC2 NDA link and Connor will follow up with the artifacts bundle by EOD Wednesday.
2) Please confirm kickoff week of Aug 3 and a preferred 30-min window; scheduling link: https://redwoodai.app/meet/marissa/30min

Attachments: SLA-summary.pdf, POC-outline.pdf
